title: Ways to Pay Exactly
statement:
A shop has `m` kinds of coins with different values, and you have as many coins of each kind as you want. Count the ways to pay exactly `A`. Two ways are the same if they use the same number of coins of each kind; the order of coins does not matter.

Print the answer modulo `1000000007`.

## Input
The first line contains `m` and `A`. The second line contains the `m` coin values, all different.

## Output
Print the number of ways modulo `1000000007`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= m <= 40`
- `1 <= A <= 20000`
- `1 <= value <= 20000`
